per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The user interface shall be easy to use for non-technical users, with clear navigation and minimal clicks to complete common tasks (e.g., account creation and starting playback).
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Users should be able to access their streaming movies in under 2 clicks after logging into the website.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Common UI interactions (opening a page or clicking a button) shall respond so they feel effectively instantaneous to the user, with a maximum perceived latency of 5 seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Any interface between a user and the automated system shall have a maximum response time of 5 seconds unless noted by an exception below.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Search queries shall return relevant results promptly and filters shall be clear and understandable; search result latency should be low enough that users do not abandon (target to be specified).
Streaming startup (time from user play action to media start) shall be under 10 seconds under normal network conditions.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: When streaming a movie the buffering time should take no longer than 10 seconds (plus any latency on the user's connection.)'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Payment processing for credit card transactions shall complete within 15 seconds from user submission to final confirmation under normal operating conditions.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'When purchasing a streaming movie or pre-paid card via credit card the processing time should have a maximum response time of 15 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall provide clear, unambiguous feedback during payment processing so users know whether a transaction succeeded, failed, or is pending.
The service shall be available 24/7 with a target uptime of at least 99.5%.
Credit card and payment data shall be encrypted in storage and access shall be restricted to only authorized Izogn staff with a need-to-know.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All credit card information will be secured on the server and only accessible by authorized Izogn administrators. Information will be encrypted in the database.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The site shall make its privacy practices and billing/subscription terms clearly discoverable (e.g., visible on signup and accessible from every page).
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall make its user aware of its information practices before collection data from them via a Privacy Policy accessible on all pages of the website.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall provide alternative non-card payment methods, including redeemable prepaid/physical cards and promo codes created by admins.
The visual design shall use warm colors, large readable text, and simple icons to improve readability and local appeal, avoiding cluttered 'spreadsheet-like' layouts.
The system shall provide easy-to-find, simple controls for subtitles and language selection.
Review features (reading and writing reviews) shall be easy to find and simple to use.
The product shall be usable by at least 90% of novice internet users for basic tasks without assistance.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product should be able to be used by 90% of novice users on the Internet.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Access to customers' credit card information by staff shall be limited by authorization and audited to prevent insider snooping.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All credit card information will be secured on the server and only accessible by authorized Izogn administrators. Information will be encrypted in the database.'
